scope: OncotreePrimaryDisease == Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma AND ModelType == Cell Line
identity_join: exact ModelID; one_to_one; no row-order or cell-line-name inference
effect_scale: released Chronos CRISPR gene effect; more negative = stronger knockout growth effect
effect_threshold_minus_0p5: descriptive triage guide only, not official dependency decision
multiple_testing: No inferential test for results.tsv; correlation context is exploratory and separately BH-corrected over four prespecified checks
transform: No new transform; expression is released log2(TPM+1)
raw_files_residency: server165 shared /public3 path; no original matrices in Git
